text:
Priya (eng-platform): initial thought: canary profile that does a short high-percent burst then a slow ramp. want quick real-traffic validation but avoid long-tail exposure.

Anna (eng-runtime): makes sense. what peak percent/duration for the burst?

Kevin (eng-platform): propose: burst 8-12% for 3-6m (exact configurable), then stepwise +1% every 90s for 30-60m. add a max_rps guard during burst to avoid spiky autoscaling.

Jae (eng-sre): telemetry: baseline p95, p99, overall 5xx rate, model error signals, and token-per-request delta. auto-stop if p95 > baseline +60ms OR combined error-rate +0.4% absolute sustained.

Maria (product): we need cohort targeting (region, plan, header flag). PMs want a simple A/B toggle and a "loss tolerance" slider that maps to rollback sensitivity.

Priya (eng-platform): also want a safety hold: if a guard trips while ramping, pause and revert to previous stable weight until an operator acknowledges.

Kevin (eng-platform): rough schema I sketched:

```json
{"profile": "burst_then_trickle", "phases": [{"name":"prewarm","duration":"2m","enabled":false},{"name":"burst","duration":"5m","target_pct":10,"max_rps":400},{"name":"trickle","duration":"45m","step_pct":1,"step_interval":"90s"}], "concurrency_policy":"singleton"}
```

Anna (eng-runtime): add an explicit prewarm path that can run synthetic requests to warm kv/cache before burst. otherwise tail latency spikes are expected.

Jae (eng-sre): also require guard hysteresis: min_window and consecutive breaches. e.g., window=60s, consecutive=3 for latency; window=60s, consecutive=5 for error-rate.

Kevin (eng-platform): updated guard example: {"metric":"p95_ms","threshold_plus":60,"window":"60s","consecutive":3}

Maria (product): console UX: show live projected finish time, next step ETA, and a tiny sparkline of delta from baseline. A/B view should surface the "loss tolerance" value and recommended rollback action.

Priya (eng-platform): alerting: non-blocking slack alert for short breaches; pager only for sustained guard trip that triggers auto-revert or manual ack required.

SRE-Bot: [auto] rollout 1720456789-bt-12 started by Priya — burst scheduled at 10% for 5m. monitors armed: p95,p99,5xx,model_errors,token_cost.

Anna (eng-runtime): another operational point: prevent overlapping rollouts for same model pair. default singleton; allow override with explicit allow_overlap=true and priority tag.

Priya (eng-platform): action items: Kevin to add prewarm toggle + examples; Jae to add hysteresis + runbook; Maria + Anna to prototype console tiles; I'll draft the API PR and validation rules.

Kevin (eng-platform): I'll also add an opt-in cap for max_rps per phase and a flag to enable synthetic preflight traffic.

Priya (eng-platform): thanks all, will convert this thread into an RFC today and ping infra/sre for review. 🙌

SRE-Bot: [auto] rollout 1720456789-bt-12: guards armed. monitoring window=60s.
